day_shape: 59 items: Khamenei reportedly orders enriched uranium kept in Iran with Trump vowing US recovery, 27-nation Strait of Hormuz multinational mission statement published, CENTCOM reports 94 vessels redirected, Chancellor Reeves updates Commons on Iran-war economic response.

threads.label: Enriched uranium standoff hardens
threads.summary: Times of Israel and Jerusalem Post reported Iran's Supreme Leader directed that near-weapons-grade uranium not leave the country, with Trump vowing the US will still recover the stockpile. IRIB carried a Newsweek piece claiming Trump's war could push Mojtaba Khamenei toward weaponisation, while ToI reported Iran is rebuilding drone production faster than expected.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz mission and blockade
threads.summary: The UK Ministry of Defence published a 27-nation joint statement on the Multinational Military Mission for the Strait of Hormuz, and CENTCOM said its forces have redirected 94 commercial vessels and disabled 4 enforcing the blockade on Iranian ports. Rubio said a US-Iran deal would be unfeasible if Tehran imposed Hormuz tolls; France rejected a NATO role, and Defa Press claimed IRGC Navy escorted 31 ships through the strait in 24 hours.

threads.label: UK domestic response to Iran war
threads.summary: Chancellor Rachel Reeves updated the Commons on the government's economic response to the war in Iran and cost-of-living measures, while Treasury written statements announced a review of mileage rates citing pressures from the war. FCDO updated Lebanon travel advice and issued a UNSC statement on Gaza humanitarian access.

threads.label: Gaza flotilla deportations and fallout
threads.summary: Israel's Foreign Ministry said it had completed deportation of all Gaza-bound flotilla activists, with 44 Spanish detainees to be released via Turkey. Poland's foreign ministry said it wants to ban Itamar Ben-Gvir from entering after Warsaw's outrage over the detentions; Iran's foreign ministry spokesman Bagheri invoked Nazism in condemning Europe's response.

threads.label: IRGC plot charge and West Bank operations
threads.summary: German prosecutors charged an alleged IRGC operative with plotting to kill a German Jewish leader, per Times of Israel. The IDF said it apprehended three Hamas-linked suspects in Hebron planning an imminent shooting attack and reported eliminating a figure who crossed the Yellow Line in Gaza.

events.title_en: Newsweek: Trump's war may ultimately drive Ayatollah Mujtaba Khamenei towards nuclear weapons
events.summary_en: Newsweek: Trump's war may ultimately drive Ayatollah Mujtaba Khamenei towards nuclear weapons. While Trump has repeatedly emphasised that preventing Iran from acquiring nuclear weapons was one of the main objectives of the war, Iran's new leader may, as a result of this war, choose precisely the path towards acquiring nuclear weapons. Iranian officials have for decades grounded their denial of seeking nuclear weapons on a fatwa issued by the late Ayatollah Ali Khamenei. At present, this war has not resulted in a regime change in Iran, and it appears Iran's young leader now possesses the same political and religious authority to issue a new fatwa. Free fuel cards at all stations in Sistan and Baluchestan will be collected and the total quota of the province with special facilitation and some increase will be credited to the card of all private vehicles.
